simple.meaning: סָחַב (çâchab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to trail along.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across 2 Samuel, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Samuel 17:13. Its contexts include city, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָחַב (H5498).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
